gods.name: Zeus
gods.title: The gathering storm
gods.disposition: Enormous in his welcome, unmistakable in his authority. He expects courage—and a place for every guest.
gods.echo: Storm-blue folds, ivory cloud curls, and lightning-gold edges echo Brontlet’s proud strut and Aetos Dios’s sheltering wings.
gods.design: An imposing mature human king, broad powerful build, warm olive skin, abundant sculpted ivory-white hair and cloud-curled beard, strong humorous eyebrows and amber eyes. A proud, genial half-smile with unmistakable authority: thunderous bravado softened by protective warmth. Navy and slate-blue ancient Greek himation over warm ivory chiton, broad layered ivory cloud-shaped shoulder mantle, clean angular lightning-gold trim. A small three-pronged lightning-shaped gold crown integrated with his swept hair, eagle-feather-shaped gold clasp. Holds one compact solid golden thunderbolt easily in his right hand; other hand open in generous welcome. Sandals and substantial human feet planted confidently, chest lifted like his eagle. Rich indigo shadows, warm ivory and gold main colors; clouds are sculpted fabric/hair, not a surrounding scene. No literal wings, animal head or tail.

gods.name: Poseidon
gods.title: The tide remembers
gods.disposition: Proud, blunt, and fiercely affectionate. His welcome can lift a boat; his displeasure moves the shore.
gods.echo: Turquoise, seafoam curls, and dark sea-stone accents follow Calfin’s sturdy warmth and Taurios’s sweeping breakers.
gods.design: A broad, barrel-chested mature human sea king, weathered bronze skin, powerful stocky human legs, heavy cream-white beard and hair sweeping in enormous curling wave shapes. Deep teal eyes, thick expressive brows, a stubborn but genuinely affectionate crooked grin, as if welcoming his favorite sailor. Deep turquoise ancient Greek draped cloak over seafoam-ivory tunic, scalloped curling foam-like borders and a few kelp-green accents. Small crown with three sculpted turquoise wave points, dark polished sea-stone belt and sandal guards edged in warm bronze. Holds one trident with exactly THREE clear tines, its turquoise head swept like the bull's breaker horns with tiny cream foam accents; free arm bent at hip, sturdy planted stance. Palette bright deep turquoise, aqua, cream, dark sea-stone, very restrained warm bronze; no dominant gold, blue Zeus robe, horns on head, mermaid tail or sea scenery.

gods.name: Hades
gods.title: A light at the threshold
gods.disposition: Courteous, exact, and quietly tender. No lost traveler is hurried through his door.
gods.echo: Charcoal robes, aubergine shadows, lilac waylight, and small coin-gold details belong beside Wickpup and Cerberos.
gods.design: A tall, composed mature human keeper with pale warm-grey skin, shoulder-length soft charcoal hair, a neatly shaped short dark beard, gently tired amber eyes and a subtle kind closed-mouth smile. Quiet reassuring dignity, NOT villainy. Elegant layered ancient Greek charcoal and muted aubergine robes, lilac lining, three softly curved bronze bands crossing the breast like the gentle hound's lantern ribs, a small luminous pale-lilac clasp behind them. A plain dark low diadem with a subtle pomegranate-seed shape, restrained coin-gold clasps at wrists. Carries a small closed bronze wayfinding lantern low in his left hand, with one contained lavender-white flame, while his free palm offers a patient welcome. Fully human, two legs in dark sandals visible below robe, an upright relaxed stance. Dark luxurious cloth remains opaque, never dissolved into smoke. No skulls, horns, spikes, skeleton, scythe, red fire, evil glare or background glow.

gods.name: Athena
gods.title: Always one move ahead
gods.disposition: Calm, keen-eyed, and thoroughly prepared. A raised eyebrow is usually the beginning of a lesson.
gods.echo: Parchment folds, olive leaves, bronze edges, and teal geometry mirror Glyphet’s living pages and Glaux Sophos’s watchful gaze.
gods.design: An athletic adult human woman with warm olive skin, strong composed face, large grey-green eyes, one subtly skeptical raised eyebrow and the smallest knowing smile. Dark brown hair braided back neatly. A bronze Greek helmet pushed back to reveal her entire expressive face, with two small curled ivory ornamental brow guards and a modest olive-leaf crest. Wears an elegant practical bronze cuirass over ivory peplos, olive-grey layered cloth panels shaped like curled parchment leaves, restrained deep teal geometric diamond embroidery matching the owl's feathers, no legible writing. Small oval olive-leaf chest brooch. Holds a slender bronze-tipped spear vertically in one hand, other arm rests on a round olive-and-bronze shield with a subtle abstract owl-eye pattern. Controlled relaxed contrapposto, not charging; strong legs, bronze greaves and sandals. Readable composed strategist, practical respectful armor, no wings or bird head. Ivory, olive-grey, bronze-gold, deep teal.

gods.name: Ares
gods.title: First into the fray
gods.disposition: All swagger until a companion needs him. Then his courage becomes a wall that will not yield.
gods.echo: Crimson crests, russet cloth, and concentric bronze shields carry Clashog’s stubborn courage into Phalanboar’s protective stance.
gods.design: A powerful muscular adult human warrior with sun-warmed copper skin, broad blunt handsome features, dark eyebrows, amber eyes and an unabashed competitive grin. Short tousled deep auburn hair and light stubble. Greek bronze helmet pushed up clear of the face, huge thick CRIMSON horsehair crest echoing a boar's mohawk. Heavy burnished round bronze shoulder guards with simple concentric ring patterns, bronze cuirass, rust-red short chiton, maroon cloak, dark leather sandals and greaves. One arm braces a broad round battered bronze hoplite shield near the hip, other hand a relaxed confident fist on his waist; no spear needed. Feet planted comically wider than necessary, leaning forward a fraction like a boar about to rush, but expression warm toward an ally. Strong and alive, loyal and direct rather than cruel. Ivory tiny tusk-shaped scrolls on helmet sides as ornament only, no human tusks or animal face. Palette crimson, rusty red, burnished bronze, dark maroon; no blood, gore or battlefield.

gods.name: Aphrodite
gods.title: An invitation to belong
gods.disposition: Warm, delighted, and impossible to overlook. She makes the shyest guest feel expected.
gods.echo: Ivory, rose petals, flowing love-knots, and a confident smile tie her to Dovelace and Peristera.
gods.design: A radiant adult human goddess with warm fair rose-tinted skin, a strong expressive face, laughing sea-green eyes, arched confident brows and an open kind mischievous smile. Long rose-gold wavy hair swept into petal-like curls with a modest rose-and-myrtle wreath. Flowing fully opaque ancient Greek ivory peplos and blush rose-pink himation, rich folds shaped like layered dove feathers and rose petals, coral and warm pale-gold edging. A sculptural rose clasp at shoulder and TWO broad soft ribbon-like draped sashes making elegant open curves near hips, attached to clothing not floating. One hand extends invitingly as if welcoming a shy guest to dance, the other gently gathers fabric; elegant planted step in coral-gold sandals. Gracious, self-possessed, powerful warmth, fully clothed graceful silhouette rather than seductive pinup. No wings, heart icons, modern dress, exposed cleavage focus or other figures. Creamy ivory and lively rose-pink dominate.

gods.name: Apollo
gods.title: Certain as the sunrise
gods.disposition: Brilliant, radiant, and a little too pleased with himself. Music can still stop him mid-sentence.
gods.echo: Sun-gold rays, copper curls, and ivory highlights recall Solisk’s sundial and Pythonos’s knowing smile.
gods.design: A luminous youthful ADULT human musician god with warm golden olive skin, clean-shaven handsome angular face, amber eyes and a bright slightly smug knowing smile. Thick golden wavy hair shaped in graceful ray-like locks, small gold laurel crown with seven short solar points. Light cream ancient Greek chiton and flowing saffron-gold himation lined warm copper-orange; fine sun-ray pleats radiate from one shoulder and a round sundial-like waist clasp with simple wedge marks but NO numerals. Holds an elegant golden seven-string lyre at his hip with both human hands clearly positioned, one poised to play. Long lithe legs in gold sandals, easy showman's contrapposto, chin lifted a fraction. Strong clean silhouette, radiant golden and cream palette with copper shadows, no navy or white old beard, no wings, no snake anatomy, no giant detached sun halo. Beautiful god of music and solar prophecy, distinct from Zeus's broad old storm king.

gods.name: Artemis
gods.title: Where the wild is free
gods.disposition: Alert, independent, and quietly playful with those she trusts. Her companions run beside her by choice.
gods.echo: Moss green, moon-pale ivory, bronze feet, and a golden crescent bow follow Cresfawn and Elaphos Chrysos.
gods.design: A lithe athletic ADULT human huntress with warm tan skin, watchful dark green eyes and a small private mischievous smile. Long dark ash-brown hair in a practical braid with silvery highlights. Small crescent moon forehead ornament and a simple leaf circlet, NO antlers on her head. Practical knee-length moss-green ancient Greek hunting chiton over ivory linen, tan leather belt, compact ivory-and-moss shoulder mantle with sparse tiny star flecks echoing the deer's coat. Bronze sandal boots. Holds one elegant GOLDEN crescent-shaped recurve bow with a clear fine silver string, lowered peacefully; compact quiver visible at back with feather-shaped pale fletching. One knee softly bent as if poised to slip silently away, attention turned gently toward viewer. Graceful adult self-contained dignity, no sexualized armor, no wings or animal ears; very restrained silver highlights, gold bow, moss, warm fawn tan and moon-pale ivory dominate.
